name: Wire in a field
doc: Wire, I = 10 A, L = 2 m along x, B = 0.5 T along y: 10 N along +z.

name: Closed loop, uniform field
doc: Closed loop in a uniform field: net force 0, to 1e-9 of I L B.

name: Long wire field
doc: Long straight wire, 1 kA, field at 1 m: mu0 I / (2 pi r) = 2.000e-4 T, to 1e-6.

name: Kepler orbit back to start
doc: Kepler orbit, a = 1 AU, e = 0.3, 10 periods: back to the start within 1e-6 a; energy within 1e-9.

name: Solar system energy, no push
doc: Solar system, 5 years, no push: energy constant to 1e-9 (Sun, Mercury to Neptune).

name: Earth-Moon barycentre period
note: mean of whole laps against the stars
doc: Earth-Moon barycentre's period around the Sun: 365.256 days, to 0.1 day.

name: Hohmann transfer
doc: Hohmann transfer 1 -> 1.524 AU: 2.94 + 2.65 km/s, about 259 days (0.02 km/s; 2 days).

name: Push along velocity, orbit growth
note: Gauss's equation da/dt = 2 a^2 v.push / mu
doc: Push of 1e-8 m/s^2 along the velocity for a year: the orbit grows by about 3,170 km (1%).

name: Cantilever under self-weight
doc: Cantilever under its own weight: root moment q L^2 / 2 and tip deflection q L^4 / (8 E I), to 1%.

name: Equilibrium temperature
doc: Equilibrium temperature at 1 AU, albedo 0.306: about 254 K, to 2 K.
